observable.method: observable Huber F-anchor increment fit; delta=1 tick; conditional 300s cluster CIs
observable.conditional_ci_qualification: Conditions on selected tau; suppressed below6 training blocks. Synthetic202/203 permanent-c intervals miss truth; not calibrated joint uncertainty. Inactive columns are unidentified.

profile_sensitivity.qualification: Descriptive grid profile within0.1% of minimum Huber loss; NOT a confidence interval.

limitations: F limit offset assumed 1; not established for real tapes.
Tau and permanent/transient split can be weakly identified; CIs condition on chosen tau.
Injected classification uses complete same-time group and generator structure.
Increment endpoint is next F anchor, not future mid or trading PnL.

qualifications: Previous-F anchor is causal and may be stale; no future anchor interpolation.
Effective variance includes diffusion, jumps, anchor error and impact-model misspecification.
1/6 rounding variance per changed anchor pair assumes independent uniform errors; heuristic only.
Tail exceedances are observable rates, NOT jump intensities or inferred regime labels.
300s block bootstrap is descriptive; fewer than6 blocks gives no interval.

qualifications: Table shape is fixed to tape_gen.IMPACT; its overall scale is fitted.
Each law uses the same transient profile, Huber delta, split and requested/filled impulses.
Paired MSE intervals condition on fitted parameters; fewer than6 holdout300s blocks is insufficient.
F-anchor increment loss is not latent-truth loss or a bot profitability comparison.

truth_audit.method: ORACLE state-labelled latent differences minus logged jumps; calm first75 fit

0.qualification: Moment-matched Gaussian conditional CI accounts for unequal dt; state boundary bins removed.

1.qualification: Moment-matched Gaussian conditional CI accounts for unequal dt; state boundary bins removed.

jump_law.qualification: Conditional iid intervals; multiple jumps in one logged interval may merge/cancel.

anchors.qualification: Uses configured impact for calm/no-jump pre-event reconstruction only; no exact on-state pre-F truth is logged.

qualifications: 10ms logger reflects last base tick; decay stops at that tick.
Diffusion/jump/dwell estimates use all truth within the selected prefix for audit, not a public estimator.
Missing un-emitted base events and rounded timestamp ties can affect alignment.
Truth sampled at regular grids; anchor uses last F before each grid, so endpoints differ.
Logged jumps aggregate10ms intervals; realized diffusion variance includes alignment residual.
